text: Keep rule pre-registered 2026-09-29 before any model run; REQ-005 voids earlier verdicts if changed; power floor documented; applied exactly.
Labels are one delegated opinion: fresh Opus 5.5 medium arbiter per 042 ADR-001, blind, no second rater or adjudication of the one disagreement.
Rows cluster by fixture (42 honest = 21x2; 9 yes = 9 fixtures; W+L=8); sign test assumes independence. Accuracy 55/56 CP95 [0.9045,0.9995] hides sensitivity 8/9 [0.5175,0.9972].
Nominal, not family-wise: Bonferroni k=15 threshold 0.003333, k=22 0.002273, p_win 0.00390625 above both; P(>=1 false keep in 15 indep tests) = 0.5367.

Check column flags a superset of the jev question's scope because allowlists are empty; B is majority, so the verdict is honest but the 22 is not a same-question comparator; allowlist population makes the bar harder.
Requalification compares provider/model only; labels sha is printed/recorded but never compared across runs. Cache grader build hash is a placeholder, mitigated by model-name+prompt-sha composite.
Single recorded execution; 027's rerun precedent exists in the campaign; the one flip shows boundary sampling noise; verdict stability unmeasured for 024.

Receipts are strong (labels sha, calls.jsonl, strict parsing, payload gate, byte-identical skips); gaps are report surfacing (per-class counts, unmeasured in the verdict line, sensitivity, intervals).
Corpus tests one hallucination family (invented local modules/helpers) on cooperative text; no other planted hallucination kinds and no adversarial outputs, though the harness has injection defenses.
